ValidationRule.description: Account Name should not be editable for DRD Profile and DRD Manager and All APS // HRP-7910
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISCHANGED(Name), ISCHANGED(Internal_Name__c) ), OR( $Profile.Name = 'DRD Profile', $Profile.Name = 'DRD Manager', $Profile.Name = 'APS Admin', $Profile.Name = 'APS Management', $Profile.Name = 'APS Planner', $Profile.Name = 'APS Scheduler' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: DRD and APS User cannot edit Account Name
